concerns.text: The specification (FR‑007) requires the system to explicitly frame all reported correlations as associational and avoid causal language unless randomized data are present. No task in the list addresses this causal‑language filter, so the requirement is omitted.

FR‑017 mandates a statistical validity check (Shapiro‑Wilk and Levene’s tests) on the ‘raw’ subset before it can be used in the sensitivity analysis. No task implements this check, leaving the raw‑subset eligibility undefined.

SC‑001 expects the best‑model R² to be measured against the baseline Linear Regression R² to quantify improvement. The tasks (e.g., T024, T025) select the best model but never compute or report the baseline Linear Regression performance for comparison.

FR‑001/SC‑007 require the ingestion step to verify that required LST columns are present and to raise a `data_schema_mismatch` error if they are not. Task T012 only aborts on download failure and does not perform schema validation, so the data‑schema mismatch check is missing.

Task T030 creates a deterministic mock fallback model for CI when real training cannot run. If this mock model were used in place of the three required regression models (FR‑003), it would constitute a weakening of the functional requirement. The task does not clearly restrict the mock to CI‑only contexts, risking a violation.
